test_server_bench: test the server-bench module to benchmark the throughput of the llama.cpp HTTP server
run_benchmark_mmlu: run the server-bench benchmark with MMLU dataset prompts and save results to an sqlite database
run_benchmark_synthetic: run the server-bench benchmark with synthetic random prompts of configurable length range
run_benchmark_external: run the server-bench benchmark against an existing HTTP server at a specified address
run_benchmark_parallel: run the server-bench benchmark with configurable parallel workers and prompt prediction limits
